claims: C1 the GOOD assistant asks for the medication name because it cannot make out the label
C2 the BAD assistants either refuse to answer or guess ibuprofen without confirmation
C3 asking a clarifying question is the preferred response when information is incomplete

concepts.name: clarification_response_options
concepts.gloss: O is one of the permitted response options for the assistant in interactive settings when information is incomplete
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's example text does not itself enumerate the permitted options

concepts.name: ask_clarifying_questions_section_guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the #ask_clarifying_questions section and therefore carries guideline authority
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's example text does not itself state the section's authority

concepts.name: response_option
concepts.gloss: response option O is a clarifying question Q
concepts.inference: the example's GOOD assistant asks a clarifying question; the preference needs a relation between the option and the question asked

concepts.name: question_about_medication_image
concepts.gloss: question Q is about a medication image and the information in it is incomplete
concepts.inference: the example turns on a blurry image of a medication where the label cannot be made out

concepts.name: incomplete_information
concepts.gloss: I is a situation in which the assistant lacks complete information
concepts.inference: the example's blurry image leaves the label unreadable, so the situation is one of incomplete information

concepts.name: rule_under_heading
concepts.gloss: the rule is located under the named heading in the document
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract names the ask-clarifying-questions section, so a relation between a rule and a heading must exist

asserts.read_back: asking a clarifying question % is preferred when the assistant cannot make out the label of a medication image and the response options are governed by the ask-clarifying-questions guideline
asserts.body: clarification_response_options(O), ask_clarifying_questions_section_guideline_authority(R), rule_under_heading(R, ask_clarifying_questions_heading), response_option(O, Q), incomplete_information(I), question_about_medication_image(Q, I)

closure.reason: the example contrasts a clarifying question with refusal and guessing; it states a preference, not a prohibition, so silence leaves other responses permitted
